summary: The game crashes when opening the inventory while in spectator mode
description: The Bug: The game crashes when opening the inventory while in spectator mode. A crash report regarding this has been attached and can be found below. This issue also doesn t appear to happen all of the time. Stack Trace: [^crash-2024-08-15_16.59.43-client.txt] Description: Rendering screen java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "faz.a(boolean)" because the return value of "ggr.t()" is null at ghd.h(SourceFile:578) at ghd.a(SourceFile:39) at com.google.common.collect.ImmutableList.forEach(ImmutableList.java:422) at ghe$a.b(SourceFile:1231) at ghd.a(SourceFile:39) at ghe.a(SourceFile:1016) at ggv$a.a(SourceFile:96) at ggv$a.a(SourceFile:85) at ggv$a.a(SourceFile:69) at ggv$a.b(SourceFile:75) at fjn.e(SourceFile:96) at fri.a(SourceFile:160) at fri.a(SourceFile:133) at fri.a(SourceFile:102) at fqi.b(SourceFile:176) at fpt.a(SourceFile:126) at fqi.a(SourceFile:113) at fra.a(SourceFile:33) at fri.a(SourceFile:84) at fpt.c(SourceFile:117) at ggl.a(SourceFile:892) at fib.c(SourceFile:1305) at fib.f(SourceFile:894) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:256) Steps to Reproduce: - Open your inventory while in spectator mode. Observed Behavior: The game crashes. Expected Behavior: The game would not crash.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft Java Edition.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Switch to Spectator mode using the command `/gamemode spectator`.
4. Open your inventory.
5. Observe that the game crashes.
Observed Behavior:
When attempting to open the inventory while in spectator mode, the game unexpectedly crashes, resulting in a NullPointerException error. This crash does not occur consistently and seems to be influenced by specific graphical settings. Based on user reports, the issue appears to be more prevalent when the graphics are set to "Fabulous." 

The stack trace indicates that the crash is related to rendering processes, specifically when the game attempts to access a null reference during the inventory rendering sequence. The line of code indicated in the stack trace suggests that the game is trying to invoke a method on an object that has not been properly initialized, leading to the crash.

This behavior interrupts gameplay and prevents players from utilizing the inventory functionality while in spectator mode, which is expected to be accessible without issues. 

**Supporting Information:**
- The crash report has been attached for further analysis: [^crash-2024-08-15_16.59.43-client.txt].
- User feedback indicates that the issue may vary depending on the version of the game and the specific graphics settings in use.
Expected Behavior: When opening the inventory while in spectator mode, the game should display the inventory interface without any issues, allowing the player to view their items and manage their inventory seamlessly. This functionality should work consistently across different graphics settings, including Fabulous mode, without causing crashes or errors. The expected behavior is that players can freely access and navigate their inventory without experiencing any disruptions or game instability.
